title: Summit Top-Up Miles for Waitlisted Miles Upgrades
content:
## Rule

In the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, a member whose miles do not cover the waitlisted miles upgrades of an upcoming trip may buy the miles short. A purchase that covers no waitlisted miles upgrade is priced at the program's price per 1000 miles purchased for each thousand miles, outside the top-up rule.

The miles a top-up purchase buys are worked out only after every choice selection of bonus miles on the membership carries its bonus credit.

The miles a top-up purchase buys are not worked out until every miles upgrade that has cleared on the membership carries its miles charge on the membership's activity.

A top-up purchase is recorded only after every choice selection of upgrade certificates on the membership carries its certificate issue.

## Member function

**Capability.** `buy_miles_4af9ade8` buys award miles, as the member, for the member's own Summit membership and pays the price. In it the member confirms a purchase of award miles on their own membership at the price stated. One call books one purchase entry dated today carrying the miles bought and the price paid; the award-mile balance rises by exactly those miles, the latest activity date becomes today, and a dormant or enrolled membership becomes active.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own function. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it through `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | Reference number of the member's own Summit membership record, as the agent reads it from the Summit membership lookup and hands it over | Id |
| `miles` | Award miles bought | Whole number of 0 or more, no decimals |
| `purchase_amount_usd` | Price paid for the miles, in USD | Non-negative amount, 2 decimal places |

**Receipt.** The call returns `loyalty_activity_id` (the new entry's reference number), `event_type` (always `loyalty_miles_purchase`), `miles`, `purchase_amount_usd` and `mile_balance` (the award-mile balance including the miles bought). A receipt carrying a `loyalty_activity_id` means the purchase is booked and paid.
